ei.subject: 중3영어
ei.title: Young Enough to Change the World

fullPassage:
Young Enough to Change the World

Many young people are making the world a better place. For example, Carter and Olivia Ries have become leaders in saving animals. Although they are only teenagers, they have actually made a difference in the world. How were they able to do that? Let's hear from Carter.

When I was five, my little sister Olivia and I each adopted a cheetah. Did we raise cheetahs at home? No, we donated to a charity that protects wild cheetahs in South Africa. Our parents told us that if we did not protect them, we might not be able to see cheetahs in the near future. We soon became interested in helping other endangered animals. A few years later, with help from our parents, we created a non-profit organization to protect them. We wanted the next generation to be able to see these animals, so we named our organization One More Generation. We also studied endangered animals and educated our friends about them.

Then one day, a terrible oil spill occurred in the Gulf of Mexico. A lot of sea animals were completely covered with oil, and they were dying. We had to do something. We started collecting animal rescue supplies such as pet carrying cages and rubber gloves from everyone in our neighborhood. Four months later, our family drove to the Gulf of Mexico to deliver what we collected and helped to save the animals. While we were working there, we learned something very useful. When we put mayonnaise into a turtle's throat, the turtle threw up. That way, we were able to get oil out of turtles. I never knew mayonnaise could be used to save animals!

On our last day, we met a marine life specialist. She told us that plastic waste is more dangerous to sea animals than oil spills are. A lot of sea animals and sea birds die from eating plastic waste. After we came home, we created an educational project about how to reduce plastic waste. In addition to this, our organization continues to do various projects to save animals. Although we started small, we are making a big difference. What you do today can change the world, so take that first step!

questions.passage: Many young people are making the world a better place. For example, Carter and Olivia Ries have become leaders in saving animals. (A)[Although / Because] they are only teenagers, they have actually made a difference in the world. How were they (B)[able / unable] to do that? Let's hear from Carter. When I was five, my little sister Olivia and I each (C)[adopted / adapted] a cheetah.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 비록 그들은 십 대일 뿐이지만 세상에 변화를 일으켰다. 그들이 어떻게 그것을 할 수 있었을까? 각자 치타를 입양했다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① Although — able — adopted
❌ ② Because — able — adapted
❌ ③ Although — unable — adapted
❌ ④ Because — unable — adopted
(A) Although: 십 대임에도 변화를 일으켰으므로 양보. Because는 문맥 불일치.
(B) able: 'be able to ~'(~할 수 있다). unable은 반대.
(C) adopted: '입양했다'. adapted(적응했다)는 철자 유사하나 의미 다름.
det.tip: adopt(입양하다) vs adapt(적응하다): 철자 한 글자 차이. although vs because: 양보 vs 원인.

questions.passage: No, we (A)[donated / dominated] to a charity that protects wild cheetahs in South Africa. Our parents told us that if we did not protect them, we might not be able to see cheetahs in the near future. We soon became interested in helping other (B)[endangered / encouraged] animals. A few years later, with help from our parents, we created a (C)[non-profit / non-stop] organization to protect them.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 자선단체에 기부했다. 다른 멸종 위기의 동물들. 비영리 단체를 만들었다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② donated — endangered — non-profit
❌ ① dominated — endangered — non-stop
❌ ③ donated — encouraged — non-stop
❌ ④ dominated — encouraged — non-profit
(A) donated: '기부했다'. dominated(지배했다)는 문맥 불일치.
(B) endangered: '멸종 위기의'. encouraged(격려받은)는 의미 다름.
(C) non-profit: '비영리'. non-stop(쉬지 않는)은 부적절.
det.tip: donate(기부하다) vs dominate(지배하다). endangered(멸종 위기의) vs encouraged(격려받은).

questions.passage: Then one day, a terrible oil spill (A)[occurred / occupied] in the Gulf of Mexico. A lot of sea animals were completely covered with oil, and they were dying. We started (B)[collecting / connecting] animal rescue supplies such as pet carrying cages and rubber gloves from everyone in our neighborhood. Four months later, our family drove to the Gulf of Mexico to (C)[deliver / discover] what we collected and helped to save the animals.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 석유 유출 사건이 발생했다. 물품을 모으기 시작했다. 전달하기 위해 멕시코만으로 갔다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ occurred — collecting — deliver
❌ ① occupied — collecting — discover
❌ ② occurred — connecting — discover
❌ ③ occupied — connecting — deliver
(A) occurred: '발생했다'. occupied(점령했다)는 문맥 불일치.
(B) collecting: '모으다'. connecting(연결하다)은 의미 다름.
(C) deliver: '전달하다'. discover(발견하다)는 문맥 불일치.
det.tip: occur(발생하다) vs occupy(점령하다). collect(모으다) vs connect(연결하다). deliver(전달하다) vs discover(발견하다).

questions.passage: Many young people are making the world a better place. For example, Carter and Olivia Ries have become leaders in saving animals. Although they are only teenagers, they have actually made a ①<u>difference</u> in the world. When I was five, my little sister Olivia and I each adopted a cheetah. No, we donated to a ②<u>charity</u> that protects wild cheetahs in South Africa. We soon became interested in helping other endangered animals. A few years later, we created a non-profit organization to ③<u>ignore</u> them. We wanted the next ④<u>generation</u> to be able to see these animals.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: 세상에 ①변화를 일으켰다. ②자선단체에 기부했다. 그들을 ③무시하기 위해 비영리 단체를 만들었다. 다음 ④세대.
det.analysis:
✅ ①difference: 'make a difference(변화를 일으키다)' 적절.
✅ ②charity: 자선단체 적절.
❌ ③ignore: 원문은 'protect(보호하다)'. 동물 보호 단체인데 '무시하기 위해'는 반대.
✅ ④generation: 다음 세대 적절.

questions.passage: Then one day, a terrible oil spill occurred in the Gulf of Mexico. A lot of sea animals were completely ①<u>covered</u> with oil, and they were dying. We had to do something. We started collecting animal rescue supplies such as pet carrying cages and rubber gloves from everyone in our ②<u>neighborhood</u>. While we were working there, we learned something very ③<u>useless</u>. When we put mayonnaise into a turtle's throat, the turtle threw up. That way, we were able to get oil out of ④<u>turtles</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: 기름을 ①뒤집어썼다. ②동네에서 물품을 모았다. 매우 ③쓸모없는 것을 배웠다. ④거북이에서 기름을 빼냈다.
det.analysis:
✅ ①covered: 기름에 덮인 상태 적절.
✅ ②neighborhood: 동네 적절.
❌ ③useless: 원문은 'useful(유용한)'. 마요네즈 방법은 유용한 것.
✅ ④turtles: 거북이 적절.

questions.passage: On our last day, we met a marine life ①<u>specialist</u>. She told us that plastic waste is more ②<u>dangerous</u> to sea animals than oil spills are. A lot of sea animals and sea birds die from eating plastic waste. After we came home, we created an ③<u>educational</u> project about how to reduce plastic waste. In addition to this, our organization continues to do various projects to save animals. Although we started small, we are making a big ④<u>mistake</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: 해양 생물 ①전문가. 더 ②위험하다. ③교육적인 프로젝트. 큰 ④실수를 만들고 있다.
det.analysis:
✅ ①specialist: 해양 생물 전문가 적절.
✅ ②dangerous: 더 위험하다 적절.
✅ ③educational: 교육 프로젝트 적절.
❌ ④mistake: 원문은 'difference(변화)'. 긍정적 맥락에 '실수'는 반대.
det.tip: make a big difference(큰 변화) ↔ make a big mistake(큰 실수).

questions.stem:
다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?
"an organization that helps people or animals in need"

det.korean: 야생 치타를 보호하는 자선단체에 기부했다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② charity: '도움이 필요한 사람이나 동물을 돕는 단체' = 자선단체.
❌ ① neighborhood: 동네.
❌ ③ generation: 세대.
❌ ④ specialist: 전문가.
det.tip: charity = 자선단체. donate to a charity(자선단체에 기부하다).

questions.stem:
다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?
"at risk of no longer existing"

det.korean: 다른 멸종 위기의 동물들을 도와주는 것에 관심을 갖게 되었다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① endangered: '더 이상 존재하지 않을 위험에 처한' = 멸종 위기의.
❌ ② educational: 교육적인.
❌ ③ terrible: 끔찍한.
❌ ④ various: 다양한.
det.tip: endangered = 멸종 위기의. endangered species(멸종 위기 종).

questions.stem:
다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?
"to take something to the place where it is needed"

det.korean: 모았던 것들을 전달하기 위해 멕시코만으로 갔다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ deliver: '필요한 곳으로 가져가다' = 전달하다.
❌ ① collect: 모으다.
❌ ② protect: 보호하다.
❌ ④ reduce: 줄이다.

questions.passage: Many young people are making the world a better place. For example, Carter and Olivia Ries have become leaders in saving animals. Although they are only teenagers, they have actually made a __________ in the world. How were they able to do that? Let's hear from Carter.
questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 실제로 세상에 __________를 일으켜 왔다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ difference: 'make a difference(변화를 일으키다)' 핵심 표현.
❌ ① promise: make a promise(약속하다) 문맥 불일치.
❌ ② mistake: make a mistake(실수하다) 반대.
❌ ③ decision: make a decision(결정하다) 문맥 불일치.

questions.passage: On our last day, we met a marine life specialist. She told us that plastic waste is more dangerous to sea animals than oil spills are. A lot of sea animals and sea birds die from eating plastic waste. After we came home, we created an educational project about how to __________ plastic waste.
questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 플라스틱 쓰레기를 __________ 방법에 관한 교육 프로젝트.
det.analysis:
✅ ② reduce: '줄이다'가 문맥에 맞음.
❌ ① increase: '늘리다'는 반대.
❌ ③ produce: '생산하다'는 문제 해결과 반대.
❌ ④ collect: '모으다'는 여기선 줄이기가 목적.

questions.passage: A lot of sea animals were completely covered with oil, and they were dying. We had to do something. We started collecting animal rescue supplies __________ pet carrying cages and rubber gloves from everyone in our neighborhood. Four months later, our family drove to the Gulf of Mexico to deliver what we collected and helped to save the animals. While we were working there, we learned something very useful.
questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 애완동물 수송용 우리와 고무장갑__________ 동물 구조 물품들을 모았다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① such as: '~와 같은' 예시 나열. cages와 gloves는 supplies의 예시.
❌ ② instead of: '~대신에' 문맥 불일치.
❌ ③ because of: '~때문에' 이유 표현.
❌ ④ in spite of: '~에도 불구하고' 양보 표현.
det.tip: such as = ~와 같은(예시). for example과 유사.

questions.passage: Then one day, a terrible oil spill <u>occurred</u> in the Gulf of Mexico. A lot of sea animals were completely covered with oil, and they were dying. We had to do something.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 'occurred'와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: 끔찍한 석유 유출 사건이 멕시코만에서 발생했다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① happened: occur = happen(발생하다) 동의어.
❌ ② disappeared: '사라졌다' 반대.
❌ ③ continued: '계속했다' 의미 다름.
❌ ④ improved: '개선했다' 의미 다름.

questions.passage: In addition to this, our organization continues to do <u>various</u> projects to save animals. Although we started small, we are making a big difference. What you do today can change the world, so take that first step!
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 'various'와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: 다양한 프로젝트들을 계속하고 있다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ different: various(다양한) = of different kinds.
❌ ① similar: '유사한' 반대 개념.
❌ ② simple: '간단한' 의미 다름.
❌ ④ dangerous: '위험한' 의미 무관.

questions.passage: In addition to this, our organization continues to do various projects to save animals. Although we started <u>small</u>, we are making a big difference. What you do today can change the world, so take that first step! Many young people are making the world a better place.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 'small'과 의미가 반대인 것은?

det.korean: 비록 작은 것부터 시작했지만, 큰 변화를 만들고 있다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ huge: small(작은)의 반의어.
❌ ① tiny: '아주 작은'은 동의어 방향.
❌ ② weak: '약한'은 크기와 무관.
❌ ③ slow: '느린'은 크기와 무관.

questions.passage: After we came home, we created an __________ project about how to reduce plastic waste. In addition to this, our organization continues to do various projects to save animals. Although we started small, we are making a big difference.
questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말의 형태로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: __________ 프로젝트를 만들었다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② educational: 명사 project를 수식하는 형용사 필요.
❌ ① educate: 동사 원형.
❌ ③ educated: '교육받은'은 사람에 주로 사용.
❌ ④ education: 명사.

questions.passage: Then one day, a terrible oil spill occurred in the Gulf of Mexico. A lot of sea animals were __________ covered with oil, and they were dying. We had to do something. We started collecting animal rescue supplies.
questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말의 형태로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 해양 동물이 __________ 기름을 뒤집어썼다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ completely: 동사 'were covered'를 수식하는 부사 필요.
❌ ① complete: 형용사/동사.
❌ ② completion: 명사.
❌ ④ completed: 과거분사.

questions.passage: We wanted the next generation to be able to see these animals, so we named our organization One More Generation. We also studied endangered animals and educated our friends about them.
questions.stem: '세대'를 뜻하는 영어 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 다음 세대가 동물들을 볼 수 있기를 원했다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ generation: '세대'의 정확한 영어 단어.
❌ ① general: '일반적인'.
❌ ② generator: '발전기'.
❌ ③ generous: '관대한'.
det.tip: generation = 세대. the next generation(다음 세대).

questions.passage: Did we raise cheetahs at home? No, we donated to a charity that protects wild cheetahs in South Africa. Our parents told us that if we did not protect them, we might not be able to see cheetahs in the near future.
questions.stem: 본문에서 'raise'가 사용된 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: to take care of and feed until grown
to collect money for a purpose

det.korean: 우리가 치타를 집에서 길렀을까?
det.analysis:
✅ ① to take care of and feed until grown: '기르다/키우다'.
❌ ② to lift something up: '들어 올리다'.
❌ ③ to increase in amount: '인상하다'.
❌ ④ to collect money for a purpose: '모금하다'.

questions.passage: On our last day, we met a marine life specialist. She told us that plastic waste is more dangerous to sea animals than oil spills are. A lot of sea animals and sea birds die from eating plastic waste.
questions.stem: 다음 중 본문의 단어와 한국어 뜻이 바르게 연결된 것은?

det.korean: 플라스틱 쓰레기가 해양 동물에게 더 위험하다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② dangerous — 위험한: 정확한 연결.
❌ ① marine — 담수의: marine은 '해양의'.
❌ ③ specialist — 일반인: specialist는 '전문가'.
❌ ④ waste — 절약: waste는 '쓰레기/낭비'.
det.tip: 반의어 함정 주의: marine(해양의), specialist(전문가), waste(쓰레기).
